candidate_evidence.quote: Ramucirumab administered intravenously at a dose of 12 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) as a one-hour infusion on days 1 and 15.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with relapsed, recurrent, or refractory DSRCT.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Cmax was the concentration of study drug in the blood after the dose is administered.

role_evidence.quote: test the safety and efficacy of ramucirumab in combination with other chemotherapy
Cyclophosphamide administered orally at 25 milligrams per meter square (mg/m2) daily from days 1 to 28.
Vinorelbine administered intravenously at 25 mg/m² on days 1, 8, and 15.

coder_notes: Desmoplastic small round cell tumour trial; glioblastoma appears only in a secondary-outcome response-criteria sentence (not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels), and CNS involvement is an exclusion, so not_glioblastoma. PK is serum (plasma-type) only. Cyclophosphamide and vinorelbine are given in both arms, coded soc_backbone.
